project_type: Next.js 16 app with Cloudflare D1 via Drizzle ORM, deployed on Cloudflare Workers
build_system: npm with Next.js, OpenNext for Cloudflare deployment
test_framework: Jest with Testing Library React, tests in src/components/__tests__/
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to verify no TypeScript/compilation errors. Run npm test to run existing tests.
environment_constraints: No Docker available. Use host-based validation only.
key_patterns: Components use 'use client' directive. Styling is Tailwind CSS utility classes inline. UI components in src/components/ui/, host components in src/components/host/, guest components in src/components/guest/. Hooks in src/hooks/. Pages use file-based routing under src/app/.
directory_structure: src/app/ - pages and layout; src/components/ui/ - shared UI primitives; src/components/host/ - host dashboard components; src/components/guest/ - guest-facing components; src/hooks/ - custom React hooks
